# Original piston model source and rights evidence

Source-only loader correction proposed 2026-10-04 under [ADR014](../../../docs/decisions/014-event-aware-shaft.md). Package `original-piston-prop-v1`, version `0.1.0-prototype`, backend model `original-piston-prop` remain the historical first-runtime prototype identity; exact source hashes distinguish its revisions. The model package's unvalidated/no-trial marker records preparation status, not a denial of the preserved historical private trials below. [ADR010](../../../docs/decisions/010-original-piston-profile.md) and ADR014 require checked exact source/reference admission before future runtime consumers. This source leaf performs no backend or dynamic-loader trial and does not accept engine behavior, realism, C172S applicability, pilot evaluation or a phase gate.

The corrected [inventory](../../../native/fdm_jsbsim/models/original-piston-prop/inventory.json) SHA256 **f7766fda173d8ee83d4c4a8c02f6333124175a1f7064d3f4d8e78df3d17da12a** binds three original XML files and the source README/parameter ledger/full MIT notice. The corrected [ledger](../../../native/fdm_jsbsim/models/original-piston-prop/parameter-ledger.json) SHA256 **eb471b5590351bee000c346acfa091a2c84ae526540794afe0e23833ca02106c** enumerates every engine/prop scalar and unit, authored numerical tables, effective pinned defaults/conversions, installation and limits. Preserve the [full first-party MIT notice](../notices/FirstParty-Piston-MIT.txt), SHA256 **ca8c1205d820d40917b54d548b97dde200bc24bc6c3166358e8bc6cc27eb0e9e**. This grant covers the original model source only; JSBSim library code remains separately registered and governed by its component/source-delivery obligations. No vendor library or corresponding-source archive is changed here.

## Original source and attribution

Engine/propeller XML and four piecewise tables were authored from project engineering choices, without copying vendor aircraft/engine XML, manufacturer manuals, calibration data, third-party aircraft art or real-airport data. Backend tag/property identifiers are API syntax, not manufacturer aircraft data. One piston/direct ratio 1/fixed-pitch two-blade propeller 6 ft in diameter installation has explicit original inputs; its MaxHP/RPM parameters are not certified limits. Positive CP is deliberately dissipative and is not realistic aerodynamic windmilling or freestream self-start. Thermal/oil computation remains internal unqualified substrate.

Five airframe XML subtrees - metrics, mass balance, original tricycle gear, pass-through controls and polynomial aerodynamics - are unchanged from the project-MIT [original-interactive airframe](../../../native/fdm_jsbsim/models/original-interactive/aircraft/original-interactive/original-interactive.xml), SHA256 0213ab8c1176e5d20b01f980da9cb94913f3e9ad8866838adc7e77bf3130722a. The inventory/ledger preserves its source and historical flight/cart lineage. Existing legacy XML/inventories and parameter choices remain unchanged. The new engine/prop/tank installation is separately original. Airframe format 2.0 and propeller sign convention 1.1 are not package versions or fidelity evidence.

## Bounded source checks and remaining gates

Source checks parse XML without JSBSim, verify exact file/hash/size/LF closure, metadata/scalar units, four table rows/strict keys, one-engine/tank/feed topology, direct ratio 1/fixed-pitch mode and legacy subtree inheritance. Negative cases include rehashed incorrect inertia units, rehashed changed drive ratio/gear/table keys/external aliases, unexpected files, invalid identity and false runtime claims. These checks establish source consistency only. Independent equations/references must freeze before model loading/traces; numerical budgets are not derived from observed output.

An original private candidate remains retained unchanged with inventory b96ec21a5d541293a3836f8838dba8de2e96116eda61ad6213d55675fe8bce77 and ledger b5273ff6d867590ba8f791ed2024713a6cec8d7485a18d2be8fc3fae6f18676a. The first publication changed preparation status/README/inventory bindings and corrected one thermal-note encoding to ASCII temperature=-9999; it retained all XML and numerical ledger fields. That published rejected v2 package is now preserved byte-for-byte as [seven historical model files](../../../tests/engine/reference/loader-rejected-v2-model/README.md): inventory f8ef5011243ef8cf16e13924a5cdc902c2055ba4789a4bfd0cba209533594b7a, ledger b59fff1d35dbd702392d12cfa4ac9477d9fafa8927454a067e60d06aaaaed24a and piston XML 0d1b3eb87f1af2131a495c26ae7a3fb2fdd2a38d3d4309c67a77daaff2cf069e. Its explicit `unit="DEGK"` is incompatible with the pinned loader, not a successful cold-runtime baseline.

## Loader-format correction and preserved trial chronology

The active seven-file model is imported exactly from preserved `c7a2886a9504034ef08e696567510330d2a0df51`, whose parent `fdd9c0d319591db69261fb6d440721498c499590` authored the correction. Piston XML SHA256 **4212b398118be77cdff44f6e41abfded7e4fd8fcfece422dba27fd64ad30b638** differs only by removing the 12-byte ` unit="DEGK"` attribute. The authored value remains 350 Kelvin; all other XML bytes, numerical scalar values and tables remain unchanged. Pinned FGPiston.cpp:242 requests target DEGK; FGXMLElement.cpp:493–497 rejects that explicit supplied unit, while the absent-unit path reads the raw scalar. This corrects model syntax rather than modifying the vendor parser or retuning physics. Updated README/ledger/inventory explain and bind that exact format change.

Historical first-loader failure receipt 60bed0b6b503a8564a7e59323363437600f2a8c328a200b362eac823062e4289 records failure before a coupled tick. Historical corrected-loader authorization f3a5a4e349b13bc8341e3f8af37e66fc1d627221642116c9401e8beec0cceb97 authorized one bounded private retry on exact reviewed source; corrected-suite receipt 87ad6b630c872ed102e694bbbb93c3d9a9ee2405912b3f37b1359caa1f5a27d2 retained two startup-convergence failures. These records establish chronology and source scope, not source merge, dynamic DLL loading/replacement qualification, engine/aircraft realism or feature acceptance.

The historical [v2 reference packet](../../../tests/engine/reference/expected-v2.json) bd2ec9562308dbb950b684018ff924c4f820278400c7a2664f1342f11f049777 and original generator c81596d5e4155463620687d987838294ef0fa39ce32157df15cbc91a7c51ebb7 remain unchanged. The corrected [v3 reference packet](../../../tests/engine/reference/expected-v3.json), SHA256 36aac20d85e841743d7eb9a357be8a0d40d8f103c1cbc60e084dde9ef23db63b, retains all 55 numerical cases and budgets exactly; only model source/metadata binding changes. The additive generator and updated static unit guard are published with the [source-only amendment](../../../docs/evidence/P3/original-piston-loader-source.md); independent final review and protected CI remain prerequisites to merge, not runtime acceptance. The [older stopping-point handoff](../../../docs/handoffs/2026-10-04-wrap-up.md) records their earlier unfinished state. Do not identify these revisions by model identity/version alone or claim runtime equivalence to the v2 model that could not initialize.

The rights-register Main URL is a locator, not an integrity or runtime acceptance authority. Checked source-only publication, new consumer admission/fingerprints, portable/exported behavior, DLL/source replacement, device compatibility, engine lifecycle/physics acceptance and pilot evaluation remain distinct gates. No new runtime pin header, native build, solver/helper output or simulator executable is supplied by this correction; issue127 stays open.
